title: Breaker B4 fault light incident
summary: Red fault lamp illuminated while breaker B4 remained half-open.
fix_summary: Reset breaker B4 and replace the contact block after isolation checks.
resolution_notes: Panel returned to normal after breaker reset.

title: Loose neutral lug at N2
summary: Thermal scan showed heat buildup and discoloration around neutral lug N2.
fix_summary: De-energize the panel, tighten the lug, and replace the damaged terminal block if heat damage is present.
resolution_notes: Senior electrician replaced the neutral lug after finding insulation damage.

title: Control fuse F2 blown after short stop
summary: The control section was dark because control fuse F2 opened after a downstream short.
fix_summary: Verify transformer secondary voltage, replace fuse F2, and confirm the short is cleared before restoring power.
resolution_notes: Control power returned after fuse replacement and short isolation.

title: Door interlock bracket out of alignment
summary: The enclosure door vibrated and the interlock bracket did not return fully to the closed position.
fix_summary: Inspect the door interlock plunger, reseat the bracket, and escalate for visual review if the latch remains offset.
resolution_notes: The service team corrected the bracket alignment after a field review.

title: Phase-loss alarm on feeder lineup 2
summary: An amber phase monitor alarm returned after a drive trip on feeder lineup 2.
fix_summary: Measure incoming phases, inspect the phase monitor relay, and reset only after voltage stability is confirmed.
resolution_notes: A senior electrician found a loose upstream connection after repeated phase-loss alarms.

title: Cabinet cooling fan stalled during startup
summary: The enclosure temperature climbed while the upper cooling fan barely rotated during startup.
fix_summary: Inspect airflow, replace the fan cartridge, and review guard alignment before returning the cabinet to service.
resolution_notes: The service team replaced the fan cartridge and corrected a bent guard bracket.
